description: Two storey front extension; conversion of garage into habitable room; single and two storey rear extension; alterations to roof to raise ridge height, form gable ends and  rear dormer; external alterations
decision_conditions: <p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><span style="line-height: 107%;">The proposed two storey front extension,&nbsp;combined with the&nbsp;proposed hip to gable roof extensions and front dormer, by reason of their excessive combined width, bulk, massing and poor design would result in an incongruous, discordant, contrived, unduly bulky and dominant addition to the host dwelling and street scene, to the detriment of the character and appearance of the property and area. The proposal would therefore be contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D.3 of the London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1(B) of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013), the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and the draft Harrow Local Plan GR1.</span></p>

<p style="margin-bottom: 0cm; padding: 0cm 5.4pt;"><span style="line-height: 14.98px;">The proposed&nbsp;first floor rear extension, by reason of its butterfly roof design combined with the proposed rear dormer, would result in a discordant and ungainly addition which would be detrimental to the character and appearance of the original dwelling and surrounding area and would be contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy D3 of The London Plan (2021), Policy CS1 (B) of Harrow's Core Strategy (2012), Policy DM1 of the Development Management Policies Local Plan document (2013),&nbsp;</span><span style="line-height: 14.98px;">the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and the draft Harrow Local Plan GR1.</span></p>
